text:
Maria: quick check — where are we on token-cost attribution milestones? need owners for the remaining gating items before the sprint cutover.

Alex: I own the telemetry ingest changes (PR #4321). basic smoke pass done locally, waiting on eng-ml to land KV-tagging support.

Devin: I'm on cost-mapping (PR #4332). blocked on a schema field we need in event.v2.token_used — want to confirm final shape before I wire the join.

Jordan: I'll take rollout and canary policy. planning a 6-hour gradual ramp with fallback to cheaper model variant. will post the rollout playbook.

Maria: perfect — can each of you call out remaining deps + ETA? also flag any prod-impacting p0s.

Alex: deps: eng-ml/kv-tagging (owner @Sam), eng-platform needs the new event contract in ingest pipeline (Devin will update). ETA EOD Thu if eng-ml lands tags today. p0 = possible missing tokens causing undercount in early windows.

Sam: kv-tagging PR is in review (DAG-128). CI found a perf regression on large seq lengths; I have a fix branch, but need time to run a longer perf pass. ETA tomorrow midday.

Devin: schema proposal (below) — please thumbs up if ok. if we add it I'll update the ingestion mapping and the cost join.

```json
{
  "event_type": "event.v2.token_used",
  "fields": {
    "user_id": "string",
    "session_id": "string",
    "model": "string",
    "tokens": "int",
    "token_category": "string", // e.g. prompt/completion/system
    "kv_tag": "string?" // optional, filled by eng-ml when available
  }
}
```

Jordan: lgtm on schema with kv_tag optional. For rollout: need a smoke test that verifies per-route unit-cost matches expected within 5% p50 and 10% p95. Can Alex/Devin add a synthetic prompt set to the canary job?

Alex: yes — I'll add a short set and wire a trace ID so we can attribute latencies to the new ingestion path.

Devin: adding synthetic prompts now. will also add a regression alert based on token-attrib delta > 2% across a 1h window.

Maria: owners recap: Alex = telemetry ingest & canary traces, Devin = schema + cost joins + alerts, Sam = kv-tagging perf fix, Jordan = rollout plan. Any missing infra or product approvals?

Jordan: product already ok'd on scope. infra: need eng-platform to schedule a maintenance window for the heavier perf smoke (Sam). Alex — can you file the window request?

Alex: filed infra ticket INF-546 (link: https://redwood/internal/INF-546) — target slot Fri 02:00–04:00 UTC.

ci-bot: build passed for #4321 and #4332 — tests: 312/312 green.

Sam: acked the infra window. will run the perf pass during that slot and post results.

Maria: thanks. final asks before I close this thread: 1) Alex/Devin, drop the PR links here when ready for canary, 2) Jordan, paste the rollout checklist (short bullets) and the smoke query for cost delta.

Devin: PR links: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/4321 (ingest changes), https://github.com/redwood/cost/pull/4332 (joins + alerts). ready for canary once kv-tag lands.

Jordan: rollout checklist (WIP):
- sanity smoke (synthetic prompts + trace ID)
- monitor p50/p95 latency and unit-cost per-route
- watch token-attrib delta alert (Devin)
- rollback policy: immediate switch to baseline model variant + stop batching optimizations
- post-mortem if delta > 5% sustained 2h

Maria: great — closing this sync. I'll update the milestone board and tag owners. ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

Alex: thanks.

Sam: will report perf numbers post-run.

Devin: will monitor alerts.

Jordan: prepping canary playbook now.

ci-bot: reminder — schedule the canary run in INF-546 once PRs merged.
